hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Assign a unique integer ID to each distinct string in original and changed.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Run Floyd-Warshall or multi-source Dijkstra across the mapped string IDs to obtain the minimum conversion cost between any pair of distinct substrings.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Use dynamic programming where dp[i] is the minimum cost to convert prefix source[0..i]. At index i, transition either with a 1-character match or a substring conversion found via Trie search.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: size of input array or string
complexity.notes: Efficient execution matching optimal computational complexity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force exceeds standard time constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m^2 + n + total_trie_nodes) auxiliary space overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify core invariants and leverage optimal structures.
